messages.subject: Order L-46037
messages.text:
Hello, 

 I’m writing regarding a recent order (L-46037) in which I received two neck warmers. Unfortunately, the pale grey one appears to be of noticeably poorer quality compared to the red, even though they were part of the same order and priced the same. I've attached photos for reference. The edge is roughly cut, the seam does not line up properly, and the fabric (or adhesive along the edge) already appears to be coming apart. It is also missing the logo that is present on the other neck warmer in the same order. 
 Given these issues, the item seems defective and not consistent with the quality of the other one I received. The fabric coming apart on a brand-new item is particularly concerning.
 I would appreciate a replacement or a refund for this item. Please let me know the next steps and if you need any additional information from me.
 Thanks,
 Caitlin

messages.subject: Re: Order L-46037
messages.text:
Hello Caitlin,
 

 We apologize for the much longer response time than usual. We are currently receiving a higher number of requests than usual, but we are doing our best to process them quickly.
 

 First, we want to reassure you that the gray neck warmer you received is not a different product; it is indeed one of our Lasclay products. However, depending on production batches or during packaging, some items may be sent without a visible label, but this obviously does not affect the quality or authenticity of the product.
 

 We do note, however, that in your case, a part is coming unstuck and this is absolutely not normal and does not correspond to the quality we wish to offer our customers.
 

 Therefore, we propose to proceed with a return/exchange. Would that suit you?
 

 Here are the steps to follow for a return/exchange:
 

 Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and your postal code, you must select the products to return and then choose those you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 Print the label, pack the products to be returned and affix the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags and not boxes, which cost more.
 

 Drop it in a Canada Post red mailbox or at the nearest Post Office.
 

 Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s). 😊
 

 Warmly, 
 

 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
